description: Regression gate for the recommended configuration: fastembed bge-small-en-v1.5, hybrid retrieval, ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 reranking of 20 candidates, rerank abstention below -8.4. Calibrated on golden_v2 at hit_rate 1.0 / recall 1.0 / MRR 0.958 overall (0.946 on the test split), with 8 of 18 unanswerable questions abstained at retrieval and no false abstentions. Run with RAG_RUN_LIVE_TESTS=1 (downloads two models; free).
